description: This PHP source file defines functions and classes related to plugin building and management within the Revive Adserver project, including template compilation, file operations, and plugin/package creation.

classes.name: OX_PluginBuilder_Common
classes.description: Base class providing template compilation, file renaming, and recursive file processing functionalities for plugin components.

classes.name: OX_PluginBuilder_Group
classes.description: Derived class for managing plugin groups, including template customization and component file copying.

classes.name: OX_PluginBuilder_Package
classes.description: Derived class for managing plugin packages, including creating plugin XML and readme files.

methods.name: getExtensionList
methods.description: Returns an array of all available extensions by calling OX_Extension::getAllExtensionsArray().

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin builder with provided values, setting up template variables and directory paths.

methods.name: _compileTemplate
methods.description: Replaces template tags in data with content from template files.

methods.name: _replaceTags
methods.description: Performs regex-based replacement of tags within a string.

methods.name: _renameFile
methods.description: Renames a file by replacing a needle string with a value from aValues.

methods.name: _compileFiles
methods.description: Recursively processes files in a directory, replacing tags and optionally renaming files.

methods.name: putGroup
methods.description: Creates or updates a plugin group XML file, copies component files, and processes directories.

methods.name: putPlugin
methods.description: Creates or updates plugin XML and readme files based on provided values.
